purpose: Prove that the existing C1 attendance export can reuse each tracked home club's target-event capacity when replaying earlier same-season home matches for frozen Pre-Live v2 b2 state.
scope: Seven home clubs present in the frozen C1 v8 nine-event training set; attendance rows available through the current 2026-10-18 audit snapshot.
query_contract: For each relevant ml_home_attendance_history_v2 row, resolve canonical club_key, then structural_prior_capacity_registry_v1 at that match date; require exactly one distinct non-null capacity per club over the audited rows.
limitations: This is a frozen compatibility audit for the existing nine-event C1 training set, not a general future capacity source.
Legia capacity is explicitly carry_forward rather than newly verified for 2026/27.
A future d2 event whose home club/capacity is outside this audit must not be silently treated as exact-compatible; a new audited capacity lineage or exporter version is required.
